title: Ye musalmano rasool e paak
body:
Ye musalmano rasool e paak
Ya husain, ya husain..(3)
Ye musalmano rasool e paak ka farmaan hai..(4)
Tumme chhode jaa raha hu..(2)
Aal aur Qur'an hai
1. Khoob hai ajre risalat mustafa ko mil raha..(2)
qatl sayyed ho rahe hai..(2)
jal raha qur'an hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jiske lab harkat nahi karte wo hai amre khuda..(2)
Kis tarha ye keh diya..(2)
tune use hizyaan hai
Mai aksar sochta rehta hu, har roz guzar yu jaae..(2)
Kya dushmani thi..(2)
Banu hashim se
Logo ki koi batlaaye
Jo waaste dono..(2)
Aalam ke, hai rahmat banke aaye
Kya uski aal ki..(2)
Khatir hai, zindaan gaye banwaye
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Dono alam ke liye jo baise rahmat bana..(2)
kya usi ki aal ke hi..(2)
waaste zindaan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Deen e ahmad ki baqa ki waaste waiz bata..(2)
juz nabi ki aal ke..(2)
kiska hua nuksaan hai
Qanoon e mashiyat ka shanasa aisa..(2)
kausar ho jo qadmo me to pyasa aisa
Dekh kar fakhr se kehte the rasoole saqlain
taqdeer se milta hai nawasa aisa
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Al husaino minni se ye saaf zahir hogaya..(2) ke husain ibn e ali me..(2)
mustafa ki jaan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ye nishaa matam ke, dil me ghum ali ke laal ka..(2)
apni bakhshish ka hamare..(2)
paas ye samaan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Naam usi hasti ke hai ye aajka nauha ameer..(2)
jo ajal se ambiya ka..(2)
momino sultaan hai
